html:
Dr Simple Bhadania

Qualification
 ENT and Skull Base Surgery

Dr Simple Bhadania is an ENT and Skull Base Surgery.. She did her MS from BJMC and then pursued Neuro-ENT at SGPGI Lucknow. She further did her fellowship at Weill Cornell University, New York in skull base surgery. She also served as Assistant Professor at Sola Civil Hospital and has extensive experience in scarless ear and sinus surgeries
